message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: impersonating tax bureau staff to obtain a credit card, then using it and defaulting on repayment. Likely crimes: fraud (诈骗罪) by using false identity to obtain credit card; also possibly "信用卡诈骗罪" (credit card fraud) under Chinese criminal law. Also "伪造、变造国家机关证件、印章罪"? He impersonated tax bureau staff, but used that to obtain card. The act of impersonation may be "冒充国家机关工作人员罪" (impersonating a state functionary). However Chinese law has "冒充国家机关工作人员进行诈骗" could be considered fraud. The specific crime: "诈骗罪" (fraud) with amount >20,000 yuan qualifies. Also "非法获取信用卡信息罪"? Actually he applied for a credit card using false identity; that's "信用卡诈骗罪" (Article 182 of Criminal Law). Also "冒充国家机关工作人员罪" (Article 336). Need to see if the fact directly supports that. The fact says he "冒充陕县国家税务局工作人员" to apply for credit card. That is impersonation. So we can list both: "信用卡诈骗罪" and "冒充国家机关工作人员罪". However the request: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The impersonation is part of the fraud. The law may treat as "诈骗罪" (using false identity). But there is specific crime "冒充国家机关工作人员罪" which requires using the impersonation to commit other crimes? Actually Article 336: "冒充国家机关工作人员进行诈骗的，依照诈骗罪的规定定罪处罚". So the primary crime is fraud. So we could list "诈骗罪". Also "信用卡诈骗罪" is a specific type of fraud. Under Chinese law, "信用卡诈骗罪" is defined as using false identity to obtain credit card and not repaying. So that fits. So we list "信用卡诈骗罪". Also maybe "伪造国家机关证件罪"? He didn't necessarily forge documents, just claimed to be staff. So not.

Thus answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗罪<eoa>
